real_cohorts: S21 session-1 source test rows are observed and may not be reused for selection or tuning.
S21 session-2 is a consumed same-person evaluation and may not be reopened for tuning.
S7 EEG evaluation evidence is consumed and may not be promoted into a fresh benchmark.
rules: Protected real cohorts and consumed synthetic seeds may be cited but not reopened for selection, calibration, thresholding, or fresh evaluation.
Future real-data access requires a metadata plan, exact file and byte caps, dry-run output, license review, and separate explicit authorization.
No target, label, prompt text, or consumed prediction may create a target-free fixture or select a future evaluation row.
Loop 25 coefficient design and its full static anti-alias gate must pass before development seed 2501 opens; seed 2502 remains conditional on a frozen development pass.

global_constraints.base_dependencies: No new heavy base dependency; numerical, neuroimaging, streaming, and edge runtimes remain optional.
global_constraints.cpu: Use one numerical thread and one worker unless a preregistered amendment justifies otherwise.
global_constraints.storage: Default generated-artifact cap is 32 MiB per loop; a lower loop-specific cap wins and any larger cap requires an amendment before execution.
global_constraints.data: No download, real-data read, consumed-cache read, model run, training run, socket, stream, board, or hardware operation is authorized by this roadmap.
global_constraints.evaluation: Prediction loops require a same-split no-signal prior and controls that isolate language, timing, peripheral, and neural contributions.
global_constraints.claims: MEG, EEG, OPM-MEG, sEMG, eye, motion, imagined speech, prompted typing, and patient evidence remain separate cohorts and claims.
global_constraints.privacy: Neural recordings and derived embeddings are sensitive, local by default, and excluded from Git.
global_constraints.closeout: Every loop closes with measured bytes, runtime, peak RSS, access counters, warnings, proof posture, and proceed, park, or kill decision.

phases.name: Causal Evidence
phases.outcome: Establish whether a fixed causal path can earn one fresh neural and transfer claim without reusing consumed evidence.

phases.name: Translation And Generalization
phases.outcome: Separate portability, interaction, neural contribution, and calibration rather than bundling them into one demo.

phases.name: Reliability And Confounds
phases.outcome: Measure sample efficiency, uncertainty, peripheral shortcuts, and geometry failure modes.

phases.name: Reproducibility And Local Deployment
phases.outcome: Make artifacts portable, privacy-aware, cross-machine reproducible, and eligible for a bounded edge-runtime decision.

phases.name: Live Translation And Release
phases.outcome: Join authorized replay mechanics to the token interface, qualify one device only if earned, reproduce independently, and promote only supported claims.

loops.title: Causal Preprocessing Audit
loops.core_question: Can every transform before the causal encoder run incrementally without future samples, evaluation-fit statistics, timestamp drift, or chunk-boundary changes?
loops.why_high_value: A causal model is not causal if filtering, resampling, padding, or normalization leaks future context; this gate protects every later streaming claim.
loops.build_deliverable: Versioned stateful preprocessing contract with a dedicated causal anti-alias SOS stage, phase-locked decimator, replay harness, transform provenance, and fail-closed refusals.
loops.research_deliverable: Pinned Brain2Qwerty-to-NeuralSet-to-MNE source trace plus filter delay, full folding-band, alias-map, resampling jitter, padding, and train-only normalization analysis.
loops.data_scope: Target-free synthetic signals first; any later S21 use is restricted to separately authorized source-train rows and may not open source-test or session-2 evidence.
controls: Seven frozen chunk schedules including whole-item, single-sample, decimation-boundary, frame-boundary, powers-of-two, and seeded-irregular splits.
Six target-free signal families, ten resume cuts, and three future-mutation cuts across physically separate seeds 2501 and 2502.
A 65,537-point 0-500 Hz response grid, 23 exact alias source probes, and complete 50-500 Hz folding-band attenuation before any fixture array opens.
Offline noncausal reference reported separately and never substituted for the causal path.
primary_metrics: dedicated and complete-chain folding-band attenuation plus alias destination correctness
runtime, peak RSS, input bytes, output bytes, and access counts
loops.acceptance_boundary: Proceed only if the dedicated anti-alias and complete chain pass the full 50-500 Hz folding-band gate before seed access, declared right context is zero, every schedule preserves samples, timestamps, and state, all forbidden counters are zero, and resource caps pass.
loops.stop_rule: Park with both seeds unopened if the static filter gate fails; otherwise park any transform that needs future samples or cannot preserve timing, and never widen tolerances after observing a protected row.
loops.authorization_boundary: Amended at green commit b6b92d8 after the v0 anti-alias scope was superseded before authorization. Await a separate exact decision through docs/LOOP_25_AUTHORIZATION_PACKET_V1.md; the v1 request is false, seeds 2501/2502 are unopened, and coefficients, fixtures, runtime, data/cache/target/model/training access, RW3, streams, devices, and hardware remain unauthorized.
loops.resource_cap: One thread, one worker, 4 MiB fixtures, 16 MiB working arrays, 8 MiB total generated artifacts, 45 seconds internal runtime, 4 KiB mutable state, and 1 GiB peak RSS.

loops.title: Real Validation-Only Encoder Gate
loops.core_question: Does one fixed, small causal encoder show neural information above no-signal and shuffled controls on source validation without touching any test set?
loops.why_high_value: The project has strong mechanics but no real neural advantage; this is the first gate that can justify continuing the predictive branch.
loops.build_deliverable: Preregistered tiny architecture, train-only fit path, six-row validation report, uncertainty, control parity, and immutable access ledger.
loops.research_deliverable: Power and identifiability note stating what six validation rows can and cannot establish.
loops.data_scope: Only separately authorized S21 source-train and source-validation members; five source-test rows and all session-2 rows stay closed.
controls: Same-split no-signal prior.
Target permutation fitted on train only.
Time-shift and channel-permutation controls chosen before validation opens.
Frozen non-neural parameter-count and compute-matched comparator where feasible.
primary_metrics: parameter count, runtime, peak RSS, and artifact bytes
raw, cache, target, model, and training access counts
loops.acceptance_boundary: Proceed only if the preregistered primary neural-versus-prior margin and all required controls pass on validation with no access violation; this does not authorize source-test opening.
loops.stop_rule: If the neural path does not beat the registered controls, park real-model scaling and move to failure analysis without touching test or increasing model size.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. Real-cache reads, target access, training, validation opening, and model runs are all unauthorized now.
loops.resource_cap: One thread, one worker, existing tiny-model class only, 32 MiB generated artifacts, 20 minutes total authorized CPU time, and 1 GiB peak RSS.

loops.title: Fresh Holdout Preregistration
loops.core_question: Which independent participant, session, or task-matched recording can answer the next claim without recycling S21 session-2 or S7 evidence?
loops.why_high_value: A fresh, hash-bound test is more valuable than another tuned result on already observed data.
loops.build_deliverable: Metadata-only candidate registry, license and byte ledger, exact file plan, split protocol, target-isolation plan, and one-time analysis contract.
loops.research_deliverable: Primary-source dataset and license review separating same-person session, unseen-person, modality, and task claims.
loops.data_scope: Metadata and public documentation only; no download, signal read, target read, or remote row preview.
controls: Independent identity and sentence-membership audit.
Exact no-signal and shuffle comparators frozen before acquisition.
One-time test access sequence with physical or cryptographic partition separation.
primary_metrics: subjects, sessions, trials, and unique sentence groups
loops.acceptance_boundary: Approve a future acquisition packet only if independence, task match, licensing, exact byte cap, split power, and one-time decision rule are explicit; otherwise record no eligible holdout.
loops.stop_rule: Hold acquisition if identity, license, task, timing, or byte provenance is ambiguous; never substitute a convenient consumed cohort.
loops.authorization_boundary: Metadata research is the only future candidate scope; download or signal access requires a separate exact packet and user authorization.
loops.resource_cap: Zero downloaded bytes, zero signal reads, one thread, one worker, 8 MiB planning artifacts, and 10 minutes local metadata processing.

loops.title: Session And Person Transfer
loops.core_question: Does the frozen causal system transfer to a genuinely fresh session or person, and how much predeclared calibration is required?
loops.why_high_value: The existing same-person cross-session result is negative; a fresh one-time test is required before any generalization claim can move.
loops.build_deliverable: Frozen source model, identity-safe adapter protocol, one-time holdout runner, calibration curve, paired controls, and claim-specific report card.
loops.research_deliverable: Transfer taxonomy distinguishing same-session, same-person cross-session, unseen-person zero-shot, and unseen-person calibrated evidence.
loops.data_scope: Only a separately acquired and authorized Loop 27 holdout after architecture, preprocessing, adapter, thresholds, and reports are frozen.
controls: Train-only no-signal prior evaluated on identical rows.
Zero-shot frozen model before any calibration.
Calibration-size curve with a physically separate final partition.
Identity and repeated-text leakage audit.
primary_metrics: CER, WER where justified, and exact sequence accuracy
loops.acceptance_boundary: Promote only the exact same-person or unseen-person claim whose preregistered interval and controls pass on the one-time fresh partition.
loops.stop_rule: A failed fresh gate closes that transfer claim; do not tune on the opened holdout or relabel calibrated performance as zero-shot.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No fresh acquisition, model run, calibration, or holdout opening is authorized.
loops.resource_cap: One thread and worker, frozen small model, 32 MiB outputs, preregistered calibration budget, and 1 GiB peak RSS.

loops.title: Portable Sensing Translation
loops.core_question: Which validated requirements survive a move from cryogenic MEG toward OPM-MEG or EEG, and which assumptions break?
loops.why_high_value: Portability is the product direction users care about, but channel-count ablation is not device qualification.
loops.build_deliverable: Versioned modality requirement matrix covering geometry, reference, units, bandwidth, noise, shielding, timing, compute, and calibration.
loops.research_deliverable: Primary-source OPM-MEG and EEG feasibility review with explicit unavailable fields and partner-data gates.
loops.data_scope: Public specifications and existing aggregate evidence only; no device session, new recording, or synthetic claim of modality equivalence.
controls: Separate rows for cryogenic MEG, OPM-MEG, scalp EEG, and non-neural wearables.
Measured device values distinguished from vendor specifications and unknowns.
Random channel ablation explicitly excluded as OPM or EEG evidence.
primary_metrics: sensor count, rate, units, geometry, and clock provenance
known versus inferred versus measured status
loops.acceptance_boundary: Proceed to a device-specific packet only when one modality has task, timing, geometry, privacy, licensing, and resource requirements that can be measured directly.
loops.stop_rule: Do not call a simulated subset, vendor specification, or file-reader success portable decoding.
loops.authorization_boundary: Research and registry planning only; hardware, acquisition, and signal reads require separate authorization.
loops.resource_cap: Zero hardware sessions, zero downloads, one thread, one worker, and 8 MiB documentation artifacts.

loops.title: Local Private Streaming Prototype
loops.core_question: Can a user inspect incremental hypotheses, revisions, timing, provenance, and refusals locally without confusing replay with live decoding?
loops.why_high_value: A trustworthy interaction surface exposes latency and uncertainty instead of hiding them behind a final sentence.
loops.build_deliverable: Loopback-only replay UI with partial hypotheses, revision trace, stage clocks, resource telemetry, warnings, and local artifact loading.
loops.research_deliverable: Interaction contract for partial output, abstention, revision, privacy, and replay/live labels.
loops.data_scope: Existing synthetic artifacts and aggregate-only real scorecards; no raw real signal, cloud call, socket, or hardware source.
controls: Replay badge and source identity visible in every view.
No-signal comparator shown beside predictive outputs.
Cold start, steady state, scheduling delay, compute delay, and render delay separated.
primary_metrics: first-token and finalization latency by stage
runtime, peak RSS, input and output bytes
network, raw, cache, model, and training counters
loops.acceptance_boundary: Pass only as a local replay interface when all source, causality, latency, unavailable-confidence, and proof labels remain visible and browser QA passes.
loops.stop_rule: Park any interface that implies live hardware, real-time text, confidence, or neural success that the loaded artifact does not prove.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. UI implementation and replay execution require a separate bounded Loop 30 authorization; live sources remain outside scope.
loops.resource_cap: Loopback only, one thread, one worker, 32 MiB temporary artifacts, 1 GiB peak RSS, and no network dependency.

loops.title: Neural Contribution Ablation
loops.core_question: When a predictive system improves, how much comes from neural signal rather than text priors, timing, sentence lists, or pipeline artifacts?
loops.why_high_value: This gate prevents autocomplete, prompt memorization, and event timing from being credited to brain activity.
loops.build_deliverable: Hash-bound ablation matrix with full signal, no-signal, shuffled-neural, timing-only, text-prior, and optional neurotoken-drop conditions.
loops.research_deliverable: Neural-contribution estimand and claim language for encoder-only and language-model-assisted systems.
loops.data_scope: Future authorized validation data only; no consumed test or target-informed fixture construction.
controls: No-signal prior and prompt/sentence-list-only baseline.
Within-split temporal, channel, and item permutations fixed before evaluation.
Encoder-only and language-model-assisted outputs reported separately.
Matched access, preprocessing, parameter, and decoding budgets where feasible.
loops.acceptance_boundary: Call a neural contribution only if the preregistered full-signal condition beats every required signal-free or corrupted-signal control with the expected direction and no leakage.
loops.stop_rule: If a signal-free or shortcut control matches the full path, withhold the neural claim and return to split, confound, or model diagnosis.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No target, model, validation, or language-model run is authorized.
loops.resource_cap: One thread, fixed small model, preregistered condition count, 32 MiB artifacts, and 1 GiB peak RSS.

loops.title: New-Subject Calibration And Adaptation
loops.core_question: What is the smallest honest calibration budget that improves a fresh person without training on their final evaluation rows?
loops.why_high_value: Subject variability is a central barrier, and zero-shot versus calibrated performance must be separated.
loops.build_deliverable: Frozen adapter family, calibration-size schedule, train-only normalization, independent selection and final partitions, and time/compute report.
loops.research_deliverable: Calibration protocol covering unlabeled, label-light, and supervised cases with distinct claims.
loops.data_scope: Only a future authorized fresh participant with physically separated calibration, selection, and final partitions.
controls: Frozen zero-shot source model.
Identity or normalization-only adapter.
Same-size signal-free prior and label-permutation control.
Multiple registered calibration sizes without final-partition reuse.
primary_metrics: gain per calibration item and minute
loops.acceptance_boundary: Promote a calibrated-person claim only when a preselected adapter improves the one-time final partition against zero-shot and prior controls within the declared budget.
loops.stop_rule: Do not call calibration zero-shot, do not pick a budget on final data, and park adapters that help validation but harm the final partition.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. Participant data, labels, calibration, training, and final evaluation remain unauthorized.
loops.resource_cap: One thread, one worker, fixed small adapter family, 32 MiB outputs, and preregistered maximum calibration minutes.

loops.title: Data Scaling And Sample Efficiency
loops.core_question: Do additional hours and additional unique sentences improve the fixed local encoder, and where does the small-data curve stop paying off?
loops.why_high_value: Scaling evidence guides acquisition better than guessing whether to collect more repetitions, more sentences, or more people.
loops.build_deliverable: Nested train-prefix runner with fixed validation, unique-sentence and repetition controls, multi-seed uncertainty, and compute ledger.
loops.research_deliverable: Local scaling design that avoids extrapolating Brain2Qwerty v2's 90-hour curve to the tiny SpanishBCBL setting.
loops.data_scope: Future authorized train and validation partitions only; no fresh test opening and no larger architecture.
controls: Nested subsets preserve participant and sentence membership.
Matched total-trial comparison of repeated versus unique sentences.
No-signal baseline at every data size.
Fixed architecture, optimizer, stopping rule, and seed list.
primary_metrics: CER versus hours, trials, and unique sentences
slope and uncertainty on registered scale
training time and energy proxy if available
marginal gain per added MiB and minute
loops.acceptance_boundary: Proceed only if a preregistered monotonic or model-based trend is stable across seeds and remains above the no-signal control; report non-saturation only within observed bounds.
loops.stop_rule: Stop the curve when gains disappear, controls fail, or the resource budget is reached; never infer a large-scale law from the bounded local range.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. Training prefixes, validation runs, and energy measurements are unauthorized.
loops.resource_cap: One thread and worker, fixed tiny architecture, at most six train sizes and three seeds if authorized, 32 MiB outputs, and a preregistered CPU-hour cap.

loops.title: Confidence, Abstention, And Revision
loops.core_question: Can the system identify when to abstain or delay output without tuning confidence on the final test?
loops.why_high_value: A decoder that knows when it is unreliable is more useful and safer than one that always emits fluent text.
loops.build_deliverable: Validation-fit confidence contract, risk-coverage report, abstention and revision policy, calibration diagnostics, and user-visible unavailable state.
loops.research_deliverable: Selective-prediction and conformal-risk review mapped to tiny correlated sequence data.
loops.data_scope: Synthetic first; any real use requires separate calibration and final partitions and cannot reopen consumed evidence.
controls: Confidence-free always-predict baseline.
Entropy, margin, stability, and prior-only confidence candidates selected on validation only.
Coverage levels fixed before final evaluation.
Sequence and item clustering respected in uncertainty estimates.
primary_metrics: expected calibration error where sample size permits
loops.acceptance_boundary: Expose confidence only if higher declared confidence reliably lowers error on an independent partition and the registered coverage-risk rule passes.
loops.stop_rule: If confidence does not rank errors or sample size is insufficient, publish confidence as unavailable rather than inventing a score.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No confidence fitting, model inference, or final-partition opening is authorized.
loops.resource_cap: Dependency-free metrics where possible, one thread, 16 MiB artifacts, and no additional model training.

loops.title: Peripheral Confound Firewall
loops.core_question: Is apparent decoding driven by brain signal, or by keystroke timing, muscle, eye, motion, audio, or prompt leakage?
loops.why_high_value: Prompted typing strongly recruits motor systems, so a positive score is not enough to establish neural specificity.
loops.build_deliverable: Confound registry, synchronized brain-only/peripheral-only/combined protocol, shortcut audits, and claim-blocking report fields.
loops.research_deliverable: Primary-source confound taxonomy for prompted typing and future no-keypress translation.
loops.data_scope: Protocol and synthetic timing fixtures first; real multimodal collection requires separate consent, retention, device, and acquisition authorization.
controls: Keystroke timing and key identity without neural samples.
Peripheral-only channels including EOG, EMG, motion, microphone, or hand tracking when actually recorded.
Brain-only channels with synchronized event structure.
Time-shift, channel-drop, and event-jitter controls.
primary_metrics: brain-only, peripheral-only, combined, and timing-only performance
loops.acceptance_boundary: A brain-specific claim requires brain-only performance above all preregistered non-brain controls and a positive incremental contribution over the strongest peripheral condition.
loops.stop_rule: If peripheral or timing controls explain the result, relabel it as task/peripheral decoding and block a neural claim.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No peripheral recording, device access, real signal read, or model run is authorized.
loops.resource_cap: Zero collection now; future packet must set exact files, bytes, retention, one-thread analysis, and 32 MiB derived-artifact cap.

loops.title: Geometry And Reference Harmonization
loops.core_question: Can channel geometry, names, units, reference, and missing sensors be normalized across sessions and devices without erasing provenance?
loops.why_high_value: Cross-session and cross-device failures can come from coordinate or reference mismatch rather than model capacity.
loops.build_deliverable: Versioned channel ontology, geometry transform ledger, reference/unit converter, missing-channel mask, and roundtrip validation.
loops.research_deliverable: Modality-specific coordinate-frame and referencing requirements with explicit non-equivalence rules.
loops.data_scope: Synthetic geometry fixtures and metadata sidecars first; real headers only after separate authorization and without opening signal arrays.
controls: Permutation, missing-channel, mirrored-coordinate, wrong-unit, and wrong-reference fixtures.
Original and harmonized metadata retained side by side.
No accuracy-based channel mapping on evaluation data.
primary_metrics: matched, missing, duplicate, and ambiguous channel counts
loops.acceptance_boundary: Proceed only when transforms are deterministic, reversible where promised, hash-bound, and refuse ambiguous geometry or reference instead of guessing.
loops.stop_rule: Keep geometry unavailable if source coordinates or frames cannot be proven; do not infer device equivalence from channel names alone.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. Synthetic fixture work or real-header inspection requires a separately scoped Loop 36 authorization.
loops.resource_cap: Dependency-free core, optional MNE only inside adapters, one thread, 16 MiB artifacts, and zero signal-array reads for metadata mode.

loops.title: BIDS Derivative And Provenance Export
loops.core_question: Can caches, tokens, reports, and split metadata be exported as inspectable derivatives without copying raw data or losing source identity?
loops.why_high_value: A standards-aware derivative makes external reproduction easier while preserving the local-first raw-data boundary.
loops.build_deliverable: BIDS-derivative export plan, dataset description, GeneratedBy and SourceDatasets provenance, sidecars, path validator, and no-raw-copy audit.
loops.research_deliverable: BIDS derivative and electrophysiology mapping note identifying standard fields, extension fields, and unsupported claims.
loops.data_scope: Tiny synthetic caches and reports only for the interface proof; no real raw file is copied, packaged, or redistributed.
controls: Source, configuration, split, payload, and code hashes retained.
Path traversal, subject collision, overwrite, and raw-copy refusals.
Roundtrip validation from derivative metadata back to source artifact identity.
loops.acceptance_boundary: Pass as a synthetic derivative interface only when provenance is complete, extension fields are namespaced, no raw payload is copied, and all generated files remain under cap.
loops.stop_rule: Do not claim BIDS compliance for unsupported fields or invent source metadata; export an explicit warning or refuse.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. Export implementation and generated fixtures require a separate Loop 37 authorization.
loops.resource_cap: One thread, one worker, dependency-free metadata core, 16 MiB generated derivative tree, and zero real-data bytes.

loops.title: Neural Data Privacy And Lifecycle
loops.core_question: Can the project prove where sensitive recordings and embeddings live, who can access them, and how they are retained or deleted?
loops.why_high_value: Neural signals and embeddings can carry identity information; local-first behavior needs verifiable lifecycle controls, not just a promise.
loops.build_deliverable: Data inventory, sensitivity labels, local path policy, retention and deletion receipts, redaction scanner, and privacy threat model.
loops.research_deliverable: NIST-aligned privacy risk map plus EEG identity-risk review and contributor guidance.
loops.data_scope: Repository metadata and synthetic fixtures only; no identity attack, real embedding export, or participant re-identification experiment.
controls: Tracked-history and staged-secret scans.
Raw, derived, report, log, temporary, and backup lifecycle paths tested separately.
Absolute paths, participant aliases, timestamps, and device serials redacted by default.
Deletion receipt verifies expected paths without destructive broad cleanup.
primary_metrics: verified deletion and unresolved copy counts
loops.acceptance_boundary: Pass when every artifact class has an owner, location, retention rule, redaction behavior, and verifiable local deletion path, with zero tracked neural payloads.
loops.stop_rule: Block data-sharing or release claims when lifecycle ownership, consent, license, or deletion cannot be proven.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No real identity analysis or destructive cleanup is authorized.
loops.resource_cap: Standard-library scanners where possible, one thread, one worker, 8 MiB reports, no real signal reads, and no network upload.

loops.title: Cross-Machine Reproducibility Matrix
loops.core_question: Which outputs are bitwise stable across supported Python and operating-system combinations, and which require explicit numerical tolerances?
loops.why_high_value: Open-source users need to know whether a mismatch is a bug, a backend difference, or an unsupported environment.
loops.build_deliverable: CI matrix, environment manifest, golden semantic hashes, tolerance registry, failure diagnostics, and artifact reproducibility report.
loops.research_deliverable: Reproducibility policy distinguishing semantic identity, numerical compatibility, timing comparison, and environment-specific evidence.
loops.data_scope: Dependency-free tests and authorized synthetic fixtures only; no real or consumed cache, target, or model training access.
controls: At least macOS and Linux where CI capacity permits.
Base and optional-neuro environments kept separate.
Bitwise semantic fields tested separately from floating payload tolerances.
Tolerance changes require a recorded failing environment and explicit decision.
primary_metrics: runtime and peak RSS by environment
loops.acceptance_boundary: Pass when every supported cell either reproduces the registered contract or fails with an explicit unsupported reason; no tolerance is widened after hidden evaluation access.
loops.stop_rule: Do not claim cross-machine reproducibility from one host; quarantine platform-specific drift until diagnosed and documented.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. New matrix jobs, fixtures, and optional installs require a separate bounded Loop 39 change.
loops.resource_cap: One thread per job, no large cache, 32 MiB job artifacts, and existing CI time limits.

loops.title: Edge Runtime Packaging Gate
loops.core_question: Can one already qualified frozen pipeline be packaged for an edge runtime while preserving outputs, state, timestamps, and measured resource behavior?
loops.why_high_value: Packaging is meaningful only after correctness and local runtime gates; it can then reveal startup, delegate, memory-planning, and operator support constraints.
loops.build_deliverable: Single-backend export contract, operator audit, packaged artifact validator, reference comparison, and startup/runtime/RSS report.
loops.research_deliverable: ExecuTorch or alternative edge-runtime decision note based on supported operators and target platform, not trend appeal.
loops.data_scope: Frozen target-free synthetic fixture only; no real data, consumed targets, retraining, or architecture changes.
controls: Reference eager path retained.
Exact frame, timestamp, decoder trace, and state comparison.
Fallback and undelegated operator counts reported.
Package size, load time, steady-state time, and peak memory separated.
primary_metrics: startup, producer, decoder, and full-pipeline latency
delegated, fallback, and unsupported operator counts
loops.acceptance_boundary: Adopt a package only if a previously qualified reference behavior is preserved, unsupported fallback is zero or explicitly accepted, and a preregistered deployment benefit passes.
loops.stop_rule: Park packaging if it requires retraining, architecture changes, hidden fallback, or more resources without a measured benefit; do not call desktop packaging portable hardware.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No export, conversion, optional edge dependency, inference, profiler, or package generation is authorized.
loops.resource_cap: One backend, one thread, one worker, 32 MiB generated package and reports, 60 seconds per measurement worker, and 1 GiB peak RSS.

loops.title: RW3 Stream-To-NeuroToken Integration
loops.core_question: Can an authorized source-chunk replay pass through causal preprocessing into NeuroTokenCache without timestamp, gap, state, or schedule drift?
loops.why_high_value: This joins the acquisition contract to the model interface while keeping replay mechanics separate from hardware and decoding claims.
loops.build_deliverable: Source-chunk to preprocessing to NeuroToken adapter, resume state, gap propagation, schedule matrix, and end-to-end provenance hashes.
loops.research_deliverable: Clock-domain and latency ledger mapping source, corrected, arrival, preprocessing, token, decoder, and render times.
loops.data_scope: Only future authorized target-free RW3 synthetic replay; no BrainFlow, LSL, PyXDF, socket, live source, hardware, or real recording unless separately staged later.
controls: Canonical offline path and every authorized chunk schedule.
Gap, duplicate, reorder, reconnect, and reset fixtures.
Raw, corrected, and arrival clocks kept distinct.
Resume from serialized state compared with uninterrupted replay.
primary_metrics: source, preprocessing, and token semantic hash agreement
stage runtime, scheduling delay, peak RSS, and output bytes
loops.acceptance_boundary: Pass only when every authorized schedule and resume path preserves canonical tokens and provenance, and anomalies remain explicit rather than repaired silently.
loops.stop_rule: Any timestamp collapse, silent interpolation, lost anomaly, schedule-dependent token, or state mismatch parks integration before live or device work.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. This roadmap does not authorize RW3 Stage A or any adapter, fixture, source-chunk, stream, or token runtime.
loops.resource_cap: One thread and worker, 32 MiB generated target-free artifacts, 60 seconds per worker, and 1 GiB peak RSS.

loops.title: One-Device Qualification
loops.core_question: Can one named device preserve declared channels, units, clocks, packets, and privacy from recorded replay through a bounded local session?
loops.why_high_value: One measured device is more credible than broad compatibility claims based on SDK imports or vendor tables.
loops.build_deliverable: Device descriptor, consent and locality checklist, recorded-versus-live equivalence packet, loss/reconnect stress report, and compatibility-level decision.
loops.research_deliverable: Device-specific timestamp, unit, reference, geometry, firmware, and data-retention review.
loops.data_scope: One separately approved board or headset, one local synthetic or consented non-sensitive qualification session, and no decoding target unless separately approved.
controls: SDK synthetic or playback source before physical hardware.
Recorded and live paths compared under the same source-chunk contract.
Packet loss, reconnect, clock reset, and buffer-drain stress cases.
Network-off and local-storage audit.
primary_metrics: channel, unit, rate, and packet identity
clock offset, jitter, gaps, duplicates, and reorder counts
runtime, peak RSS, bytes, and dropped samples
loops.acceptance_boundary: Qualify only the named device, firmware, transport, host, and tested compatibility level; connectivity alone cannot qualify signal quality or decoding.
loops.stop_rule: Park physical qualification on ambiguous consent, cloud dependence, hidden timestamps, unstable identity, unsafe retention, or failed replay equivalence.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No SDK import, device discovery, socket, stream, board, hardware, or recording session is authorized.
loops.resource_cap: One device, one host, one thread for analysis, exact session and byte cap in a future packet, 32 MiB derived artifacts, and no cloud upload.

loops.title: Independent Reproduction Challenge
loops.core_question: Can an independent contributor reproduce a bounded claim from documented inputs without private guidance or sharing neural recordings?
loops.why_high_value: Independent reproduction tests the developer experience, evidence contracts, and contribution path more honestly than another maintainer-run demo.
loops.build_deliverable: Challenge packet, fixture manifest, expected semantic checks, environment capture, blinded result card, and discrepancy triage workflow.
loops.research_deliverable: Reproduction protocol distinguishing exact replication, computational reproduction, and extension on contributor-owned data.
loops.data_scope: Public code plus tiny synthetic fixtures by default; contributors keep any owned EEG local and submit metadata/aggregate reports only.
controls: Maintainer and contributor environments recorded independently.
Expected results hidden where needed until submission hash freezes.
No private recording, secret, absolute path, or participant identifier in the submission.
Negative and failed reproductions retained.
primary_metrics: contributor artifact bytes and privacy findings
loops.acceptance_boundary: Pass when at least one independent environment reproduces the registered artifact contract and a discrepancy, if any, is resolved or documented without moving the claim boundary.
loops.stop_rule: Do not promote a result that depends on undocumented maintainer state, private hand edits, leaked data, or an unreviewed tolerance change.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. No outreach, external data exchange, or challenge execution is authorized by the roadmap file.
loops.resource_cap: Tiny public fixtures only, one-thread reference commands, 32 MiB submission cap, and no neural recording upload.

loops.title: Claim Promotion And Release Decision
loops.core_question: Which engineering and scientific claims have earned promotion into a release, and which remain fixture-backed, negative, unavailable, parked, or killed?
loops.why_high_value: The roadmap should end in an evidence decision, not an accumulation of features or optimistic wording.
loops.build_deliverable: Machine-readable evidence matrix, model and dataset cards, release checklist, claim diff, risk register, and signed proceed, park, or kill decision.
loops.research_deliverable: Release and reporting policy grounded in model cards, datasheets, privacy, licensing, and reproducibility evidence.
loops.data_scope: Artifact-only synthesis of closed loop reports; no raw, consumed, target, model, training, device, or network operation.
controls: Every claim links to a cohort, split, comparator, uncertainty, resource, and access record.
Negative results and unavailable fields remain visible.
Engineering capability and scientific performance are stated separately.
Clinical, arbitrary-thought, portable-hardware, and real-time claims default to unavailable.
primary_metrics: claims promoted, parked, killed, and unavailable
unresolved privacy, license, security, and reproducibility blockers
loops.acceptance_boundary: Release only the subset whose exact evidence cards, licenses, privacy controls, independent reproduction, tests, and claim language pass; all other claims stay explicitly unestablished.
loops.stop_rule: Hold the release rather than soften a failed gate, omit a negative comparator, or convert an engineering interface proof into a decoding claim.
loops.authorization_boundary: Planning only. The future release decision cannot retroactively authorize or upgrade any earlier experiment.
loops.resource_cap: Artifact-only review, one thread, one worker, 16 MiB generated reports, zero data/model/training/device access, and complete link/test checks.
